scope: Independent source/test review only. No raw process trace data opened; native CLI not invoked; tests not rerun.

previous_findings.evidence: Requires receipt_schema_version=1, OLD/FIX case, status and full-prefix true, exact ordered [12,13,14]; gate bytes are hashed at read and checked before/after parsing and before publication; tests reject unsupported schema and wrong time order.

Stores source path/file ordinal and requires joined PREVP/update events to come from one source file; checks phase chronology by same-file line number; emits stable source/file-ordinal/line order. Test rejects split-file update transaction.
Initializes count map with every declared SCHEMAS phase at zero; test asserts exact 15-key schema coverage.

Separates observed-after minus REAL32 expected residual from change-equation diagnostic. Summary labels these unthresholded diagnostics and pass status is schema/join validation only; no undue bitwise-equality claim.
Stages both arms under the output parent and renames the completed pair into a new target; existing targets are refused; test checks second-arm failure leaves no published output.
Hashes gate bytes from same read object and rechecks; trace bytes are hash-checked before and after parse; summary binds both gate hashes and trace hashes/sizes.

review_checks: Schema v1 and strict full-prefix case/time gate are checked before either trace inventory is opened.

Optional PREVP formula/raw/cap phases are joined with required update phases; raw/formula presence is paired, caps require raw, duplicate phase keys fail, and signed zero is classified from the exact f32 word.
n0r is decoded and emitted as REAL64 with its raw 64-bit word; remaining transfer values are finite REAL32.
All 15 phase counts appear, including zeros; output event rows include source, ordinal/line chronology and phase transfer words.
Local q/T arithmetic uses explicit REAL32 rounding but is not declared closed or thresholded.
Process sums remain separate by point, corner, model level, and hour; no density multiplier or column/area budget is claimed.

execution_condition.detail: Code requires --scratch and --out parent to share a device, but that alone does not prove the device is the large NHNHOME filesystem. Before raw parsing, verify both requested paths resolve on NHNHOME (and that required free capacity is available); the phase-record CSV and staged output can be large.

minor_note: `shutil` is imported but unused; cosmetic only.

post_go_addendum.rationale: Both operands are the schema-paired PREVP_FORMULA/PREVP_RAW REAL32 `prevp` values for the same transaction key. It is emitted only when PREVP_RAW exists; join validation already requires matching formula presence. The field does not affect gates, joins, count classification, or outputs beyond one numeric delta.
